candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients, where higher numbers indicate greater disability.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical ECOG score from the patient's clinical assessment.
candidates.measurement_definition: Standard Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status scale ranging from 0 to 4.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The timing of these assessments relative to the initiation of therapy varies across patient records.

candidates.description: A measure of kidney function indicating the rate at which glomeruli filter blood.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical value for eGFR from laboratory results.
candidates.measurement_definition: Renal filtration rate measured in mL/min or mL/min/1.73 m².
candidates.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR)
candidates.uncertainty: There is inconsistency in the reporting units (mL/min vs mL/min/1.73 m²) and the specific formula used (e.g., CKD-EPI).

limitations: Limited number of patient examples provided.
Inconsistent units for renal function measurements across different evidence chunks.
summary: The evidence identifies performance status and renal function as baseline clinical variables used in the assessment of patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) prior to systemic therapy.
